clock: local wall-clock time from UTC via zoneinfo; DST days padded/trimmed to 24 rows (the skipped spring-forward hour repeats the row before it, the repeated fall-back hour keeps its first)
dst: utc_offset_seconds is standard time; hours, sunrise and sunset are wall-clock, DST applied
